description: This file contains the PHP class 'FlushTokenParser' within the 'Twig' templating engine, responsible for parsing the 'flush' tag to generate output flushing behavior.

classes.name: FlushTokenParser
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTokenParser that handles parsing of the 'flush' tag in Twig templates, generating a FlushNode to flush output.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'flush' tag token and returns a new FlushNode initialized with the current token's line number.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'flush', which is the tag name this parser handles in templates.
